scripts.build: bun run build:islands && bun run --filter @demo-archive/astro-site build
scripts.dev:all: bun run --filter './packages/island-*' dev & bun run --filter @demo-archive/astro-site dev
scripts.clean: find packages -maxdepth 3 \( -name dist -o -name node_modules \) -exec rm -rf {} + && rm -rf node_modules
